offres.titre: Strategy & Consulting - Graduate Management Consulting Analyst
offres.extrait:
Position Overview:
 We are seeking highly motivated and talented individuals to join our Strategy & Consulting team as a Graduate Analyst. This is an excellent opportunity for recent/ upcoming graduates who are passionate about strategy, problem-solving, and doing impactful work in the business world. As an Analyst, you will work closely with senior consultants on various client projects, gaining invaluable experience and exposure to different industries and business challenges.
 Key Responsibilities:
 Assist in conducting research and analysis to support the development of client strategies and solutions
 Participate in client meetings and workshops, contributing insights and ideas to help solve complex business problems
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather data, perform analysis, and develop recommendations
 Prepare presentations, reports, and other deliverables for clients, ensuring accuracy and clarity of information
 Provide insights on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies to enhance consulting services
 To succeed in this role, you should:
 demonstrate passion for consulting, strategy, and business innovation
 possess strong analytical and…

The work 
 We are Accenture’s Corporate Strategy & Growth (CS&G) practice. We help shape our clients’ strategy from the C-Suite level and thus enable them to deliver high performance and achieve growth that is sustainable. We own the strategic narrative and orchestrate strategic transformations. As part of our fast-growing Corporate Strategy & Growth team, we are looking for a Strategy Consultant. As a consultant you will work in a high-performance environment with young and enthusiastic colleagues to address priority C-suite issues with precision and speed. You will take on responsibility for your own workstreams within projects and give guidance to analysts. You will also be involved in actively growing and developing our Amsterdam-based team, where you can express your entrepreneurial capabilities.
- Team: The CS&G team operates across Europe as a strategy-only function. You will be part of our diverse, European-wide network of 124 colleagues. At the same time, you will start in our small and ambitious Dutch team which aims to grow quickly during the coming years. offres.titre: Chargé de mission stratégie habitat - CONSEIL DEPARTEMENTAL DU NORD
offres.extrait:
Employeur : Conseils départementaux
La Direction Territoires et Transition (DTT) contribue à l'exercice du chef de filât "solidarités territoriales" du Département, principalement autour de 3 grands objectifs : Améliorer le cadre de vie et les services aux Nordistes, en particulier les plus petites communes ; Favoriser le rayonnement et l'attractivité des territoires en agissant sur leurs forces et leurs potentiels ; Agir pour une transition écologique et solidaire des territoires, dont transfrontaliers, dans une optique d'équité, tenant compte des situations économiques, sociales et financières variées des territoires. Elle se compose de 4 services : le service Accompagnement des Territoires (SAT), le service Stratégies et Partenariats (SSP), le service Renouveaux Urbains et Habitat (SRUH) et le service Tourisme.La Direction pilote également l’animation de l’Observatoire des territoires en transversalité avec les services et les autres Directions utilisatrices, ainsi que le Schéma Départemental d’Amélioration de l’Accessibilité des Services au Public (SDAASP), en lien avec la Préfecture du Nord.Au sein de la DTT en qualité de chargé de mission stratégie et partenariat vous…

About Us
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with.
